title: First-query Embeddings Onboarding Flow & Rerank Playground Screens
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Goal: Deliver a concise set of onboarding visuals and screenshot assets that demonstrate the user journey from first query to rerank results for embeddings use-cases. Scope includes: 1) a simplified pipeline diagram showing text -> embed -> index -> initial retrieval -> rerank -> ranked results, 2) two high-fidelity walkthrough screens (desktop + mobile) for the onboarding modal, 3) a lightweight ‘Rerank Playground’ UI mock that shows score deltas and explainability hints, and 4) a sample outputs pack (CSV + PNGs + text samples) for docs and the quickstart guide. Deliverables will emphasize clarity for new users, highlight cost/latency tradeoffs, and include accessibility alt-text for all images.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline diagram (SVG) that matches platform terminology (Embed, Index, Retrieve, Rerank) and fits header width 1200px
Desktop onboarding screens: full-flow mock (3 screens) exported at 1x, 2x, 3x with annotated callouts
Mobile onboarding screens: condensed flow (2 screens) optimized for 375px width
Rerank Playground mock with interactive state examples (original vs reranked list) and sample scores
Sample outputs: 6 example queries with original retrieval snippets and reranked ordering (CSV + human-readable text file)
Design handoff notes, component tokens, and alt-text file added to Drive with Dev/Docs links
Design reviewed and signed off by PM + Docs + Engineering UX reviewer
